scientific_role: Discovery of a predictive liquidity-impulse mechanism. 2024 market outcomes remain locked for independent replication.
source_dependency: SSLI_SOURCE_FULL or SSLI_SOURCE_LIMITED; BLOCKED stops before outcomes.

signal.threshold: g7_t > 0 AND g7_t >= past-only trailing 90th percentile of g7
signal.event_overlap: one active 7-day event at a time; signals before the current event exits are ignored

discovery_period.reason: All next-day entries and 7-day exits remain inside 2021-2023. 2024 is reserved and unopened.

market_outcome.portfolio_return: equal-weight mean of BTC and ETH log returns
market_outcome.note: Predictive market-return Discovery only, not an executable trading strategy.

diagnostics_frozen_before_outcomes.prior_7d_market_return: equal-weight BTC/ETH log return from t-7 open to t open, descriptive only
diagnostics_frozen_before_outcomes.purpose: Detect whether stablecoin supply impulses simply follow recent crypto performance; not a gate and not a filter.

primary_statistics.bootstrap: 10000 circular moving-block resamples of non-overlapping event returns

replication_rule: Only if Discovery passes may a separately frozen 2024 replication be opened. No 2024 market outcome is accessed by this MVE.
no_rescue: Do not change 7-day supply growth after outcomes.
Do not change the 180-day trailing reference after outcomes.
Do not change the 90th percentile threshold after outcomes.
Do not change the 7-day forward horizon after outcomes.
Do not add momentum, volatility, funding, or macro filters after outcomes.
Do not invert the signal after outcomes.
Do not open 2024 to rescue a failed Discovery.
